name: fraud-detector
intended_use: used to find possible fraudulent card transactions for review. it should only help with screening and should not be the only reason to reject a transaction.
training_data: trained using the transaction data provided for this assignment. the model can only learn patterns that are present in this data.
limitations: this is a simple amount based fraud classifier. it can miss some fraud and can also flag normal transactions by mistake.
ethical_considerations: false positives can affect normal customers, while false negatives can allow fraud. the model should be used with human review.
